pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'the girl' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le garçon
   B. la fille
   C. le père
   D. la famille

2. Which little word goes with 'dent' (the tooth)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. la

3. What does 'C'est bon pour la santé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   B. I like milk.
   C. It is good for your health.
   D. They are oranges.

4. How do you say the month 'November' in French? (1 mark)
   A. janvier
   B. février
   C. décembre
   D. novembre

5. How do you say 'I have two eyes.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux yeux.
   B. J'ai une bouche.
   C. J'ai deux mains.
   D. J'ai deux pieds.

6. What does 'Voici ma grand-mère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My mother is called Grace.
   B. Here is my grandmother.
   C. My sister is called Njeri.
   D. Here is my grandfather.

7. Fill in: Tu as quel ______ ? (1 mark)
   A. nom
   B. mois
   C. jour
   D. âge

8. How do you say 'the foot' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pied
   B. la bouche
   C. le genou
   D. le bras

9. How do you say 'Happy birthday!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.
   B. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   C. Bon anniversaire !
   D. J'ai neuf ans.

10. What does 'l'école' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the day
   B. the school
   C. the church
   D. the week

11. Fill in: Il est ______. (tall) (1 mark)
   A. petite
   B. longue
   C. grand
   D. grande

12. How do you say 'A week, seven days.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   B. Le samedi, je joue.
   C. Une semaine, sept jours.
   D. Le lundi, je vais à l'école.

13. How do you say 'the weather' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le temps
   B. l'orage
   C. la pluie
   D. une inondation

14. How do you say 'It is sunny.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Quel temps fait-il ?
   B. Il y a du vent.
   C. Il y a du soleil.
   D. Il fait beau.

15. How do you say 'to the right' in French? (1 mark)
   A. à droite
   B. près de
   C. à gauche
   D. à côté de

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into French: 'I eat a mango.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Write three sentences in French to say where things are in your house. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Explain how to search safely on the internet when you look for a text about the body. (4 marks) (4 marks)

19. Translate into English: 'La télé est sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'Il pleut.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — la fille
   the girl in French is la fille.

2. D — la
   dent is feminine, so we say la dent.

3. C — It is good for your health.
   C'est bon pour la santé. means It is good for your health.

4. D — novembre
   November in French is novembre.

5. A — J'ai deux yeux.
   I have two eyes. in French is J'ai deux yeux.

6. B — Here is my grandmother.
   Voici ma grand-mère. means Here is my grandmother.

7. D — âge
   Quel âge means how old.

8. A — le pied
   the foot in French is le pied.

9. C — Bon anniversaire !
   Happy birthday! in French is Bon anniversaire !

10. B — the school
   l'école means the school.

11. C — grand
   For a boy we say grand.

12. C — Une semaine, sept jours.
   A week, seven days. in French is Une semaine, sept jours.

13. A — le temps
   the weather in French is le temps.

14. C — Il y a du soleil.
   It is sunny. in French is Il y a du soleil.

15. A — à droite
   to the right in French is à droite.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Je mange une mangue.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: La télé est dans le salon. Le lit est dans la chambre. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ask an adult first, turn Safe Search on, open only pages the teacher or adult approves, and close the page when finished.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: The TV is on the table.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is raining.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.
